name: nwscript-lsp
description: Language server for NWScript (Neverwinter Nights scripting language) — completions, diagnostics, go-to-definition, hover, formatting, and more.

nwscriptLsp.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `nwn_script_comp` compiler binary. If empty, uses the bundled binary or searches `PATH`.

nwscriptLsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `nwscript-lsp` server binary. If empty, uses the bundled binary or searches `PATH`.

nwscriptLsp.nwnRoot.markdownDescription: Path to NWN:EE installation directory (contains `data/` with KEY/BIF files). If empty, auto-detected from `NWN_ROOT` env var, Steam, Beamdog, or GOG paths. Used to extract vanilla scripts for include resolution and go-to-definition.

nwscriptLsp.nwscriptNssPath.markdownDescription: Path to `nwscript.nss` (engine built-in definitions). If empty, extracted from NWN installation or searched in workspace.

nwscriptLsp.extractVanillaScripts.markdownDescription: Extract vanilla `.nss` scripts from the NWN:EE installation (KEY/BIF files) for include resolution and go-to-definition. Disable if you only need `nwscript.nss` and want faster startup.

nwscriptLsp.includeDirs.markdownDescription: Additional include directories for NWScript source files. These are added alongside directories discovered from `nasher.cfg`.

nwscriptLsp.excludeDirs.markdownDescription: Directory names to exclude from source scanning. Directories starting with `.` are always excluded. Use this to skip folders that contain `.nss` files you don't want indexed (e.g., `docs`, `reference`).

nwscriptLsp.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription: Show parameter name inlay hints at call sites (e.g. `nObjectType: 1`). Also requires VS Code's `editor.inlayHints.enabled` to be on.

nwscriptLsp.inlayHints.suppressForSingle.markdownDescription: Hide inlay hints for function calls with only one argument.

enumDescriptions: Allman style — opening brace on its own line
K&R style — opening brace on the same line as the statement

nwscriptLsp.formatter.maxLineWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum line width before wrapping function parameters and call arguments to one-per-line.

nwscriptLsp.formatter.maxBlankLines.markdownDescription: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines allowed. Extra blank lines are collapsed.

nwscriptLsp.formatter.sortIncludes.markdownDescription: Sort `#include` directives alphabetically (case-insensitive). Associated comments travel with their include.

nwscriptLsp.formatter.spaceAfterKeywords.markdownDescription: Space between control keywords and parentheses: `if (x)` vs `if(x)`.

nwscriptLsp.formatter.spaceAroundOperato.markdownDescription: Spaces around binary operators: `a + b` vs `a+b`.

nwscriptLsp.formatter.spaceAfterComma.markdownDescription: Space after commas in parameter lists and arguments: `f(a, b)` vs `f(a,b)`.

scripts.package:win: npm run package && npx @vscode/vsce package --target win32-x64 --allow-missing-repository
scripts.package:linux: npm run package && npx @vscode/vsce package --target linux-x64 --allow-missing-repository
